# cloudsmith_service_list (Data Source)

Retrieve all service accounts within a Cloudsmith organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "org" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

data "cloudsmith_service_list" "services" {
  organization = data.cloudsmith_organization.org.slug_perm
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization within which to list service accounts.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Search query (e.g. 'name:my-service' or 'role:Member').
- `sort` (String) Sort field (e.g. 'created_at', '-created_at', 'name', '-name', 'role').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
